data.summary: Example Harbor Federal Credit Union asks Chidi Okonkwo, now living outside the US, to return a signed Form W-8BEN by September 13, 2027, to keep the savings account free of US backup withholding on interest.
data.explanation: The credit union needs proof of your foreign tax status because you now live outside the US. Sign the enclosed Form W-8BEN and send it back to Member Services by the stated deadline. If the form does not arrive in time, the bank says it must withhold 24% of any interest it pays into your account going forward, so it is worth sending it promptly, by mail or however the credit union accepts it.
